5. Muslim ki thi wasiyat, do mere laadle hai

mar jaau jab mai koi..(2)

<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dhundho yahi kahi'n hai, unse bhi badla lunga

ghaazi ke bhanjo ko..(2)

<<DIVIDER>>
7. Koofe ke darr pe jisdum, muslim ki laash dekhi
akbar kaha ye maa ne, ro ro ke mere waali
batla de bus kaha'n hai..(2)
aaqa kaneez zaade
